meta.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages

services.name: Acadian Ambulance Service
services.ownership: private (contractor to Harrison County and three cities)
services.area: Harrison County and D'Iberville, Long Beach, Pass Christian (all but Biloxi and Gulfport)
services.evidence: Acadian Ambulance Service is beginning 911 emergency response service in Harrison County and the cities of D’Iberville, Long Beach, and Pass Christian, effective 7:00 a.m. May 1, 2024.

services.name: Pafford EMS of Mississippi
services.evidence: The ambulance company services the cities of Biloxi and Gulfport, along with Hancock and Stone counties.

28047.page_note: Acadian Ambulance Service answers 911 ambulance calls in Harrison County outside Biloxi and Gulfport, including D'Iberville, Long Beach and Pass Christian (county contract since May 1, 2024; still operating in 2026). Pafford EMS answers 911 ambulance calls in the cities of Biloxi and Gulfport.

services.name: Acadian Ambulance Service
services.evidence: Acadian Ambulance has been honored to serve the residents of Jackson County since 2000

28059.page_note: Acadian Ambulance Service is the Jackson County ambulance provider under a county contract (renewed by the Board of Supervisors in 2016; Acadian says it has served the county since 2000 and still does in 2026). The county ordinance names a single operations contractor for all emergency ambulance calls in the county.

services.name: Pafford EMS of Mississippi
services.evidence: Deputies, Rankin County Emergency Operations, the Star Fire Department and Pafford Ambulance Service responded to the scene.

28121.page_note: Pafford EMS answers 911 ambulance calls in Rankin County: it took the cities of Pearl and Brandon from AMR in 2015 and began an exclusive county contract in June 2016, and it was the ambulance at 2024-2026 calls in Pearl, Brandon, Flowood, Star, Reservoir and Puckett. No fire department in the county holds an ambulance transport licence.

services.name: Pafford EMS of Mississippi
services.evidence: the child was transported to UMMC by Pafford

28089.page_note: Pafford EMS answers 911 ambulance calls in Madison County: the Board of Supervisors replaced AMR with Pafford as the county ambulance provider in May 2016, and Pafford transported patients from Madison (2024), Ridgeland (2024) and Gluckstadt (2026). The Madison and Ridgeland fire departments are licensed for non-transport care only.

services.name: Pafford EMS of Mississippi
services.ownership: private (contractor to the City of Meridian EMS district)
services.evidence: It was explained though that Pafford is the city’s EMS provider, while Metro remains the provider for Lauderdale County.

services.name: Metro Ambulance Service
services.ownership: mixed: government department formed by the city and county, funded by billing
services.area: Lauderdale County outside the City of Meridian
services.evidence: Lauderdale County residents outside the city limits will continue to receive service from Metro Ambulance.

28075.page_note: Since September 18, 2026 Pafford EMS answers 911 ambulance calls inside the City of Meridian and Metro Ambulance Service answers them in the rest of Lauderdale County.

services.name: EMServ Ambulance Service
services.evidence: Both patients were transported by EMServ to South Central Medical Center for treatment.

28067.page_note: EMServ Ambulance Service answers 911 ambulance calls in Jones County: it transported patients from Powers, Moselle, Glade, Laurel and Ellisville in 2025-2026. A county or city page, contract or board record naming the 911 ambulance provider for Jones County, including Laurel, has not been found.

services.name: Baptist Ambulance (Baptist Memorial Hospital-North Mississippi, operated with Priority Ambulance)
services.ownership: hospital (operated with Priority Ambulance, a private contractor)
services.area: whole county, Oxford city and county
services.evidence: Lafayette County Board of Supervisors has granted Baptist Ambulance of Baptist Memorial Hospital North Mississippi priority on all 911 calls

28071.page_note: Baptist Ambulance (Baptist Memorial Hospital-North Mississippi, run with Priority Ambulance) holds the Lafayette County 911 ambulance priority under a county agreement and was still the ambulance at calls in Oxford and the county in 2026. CareMed EMS does private transports only.

services.name: AAA Ambulance Service
services.ownership: private (contractor to the county and two cities)
services.area: whole county incl. Picayune and Poplarville
services.evidence: The Board did approve a contract with AAA Ambulance Services to provide five ambulances instead of four to the county and the cities of Poplarville and Picayune.

28109.page_note: AAA Ambulance Service holds the Pearl River County ambulance contract (county and the cities of Picayune and Poplarville); the Board of Supervisors accepted its monthly report in 2025 and Picayune extended its contract in April 2026.

services.name: Pafford EMS of Mississippi
services.area: whole county (Kiln, Waveland, Bay St. Louis, Diamondhead)
services.evidence: Pafford Emergency Services is taking over in Hancock County.

28045.page_note: Pafford EMS took over 911 ambulance service in Hancock County on May 24, 2024 and still serves it in 2025.

services.name: Pafford EMS of Mississippi
services.evidence: Officers began providing aid until Pafford Ambulance Service arrived

28151.page_note: Pafford EMS answers 911 ambulance calls in Washington County: it was the ambulance at a Greenville call in 2026, and its station list names Greenville, Leland and Hollandale. A county or city page, contract or board record naming the 911 ambulance provider for Washington County, including Greenville, has not been found.

services.name: Pafford EMS of Mississippi
services.ownership: private (contractor to the county, Wiggins and Memorial Hospital at Stone County)
services.evidence: The Stone County Board of Supervisors approved a three-year contract with Pafford Emergency Medical Services for ground ambulance for Stone County, Wiggins, and Memorial Hospital at Stone County.

28131.page_note: Pafford EMS holds a three-year ground ambulance contract with Stone County, the City of Wiggins and Memorial Hospital at Stone County, in effect since November 4, 2024, and still served the county in 2025.

services.name: Acadian Ambulance Service
services.evidence: Acadian Ambulance Service has begun 911 emergency response service in George County, Mississippi, effective 8:00 a.m. October 6, 2026.

28039.page_note: Acadian Ambulance Service has answered 911 ambulance calls in George County since October 6, 2026, replacing AmeriPro Health.

services.name: Vicksburg Fire Department Ambulance Service
services.area: whole county (jet ski call in North Warren County, 2026-07-29)
services.evidence: two adult patients were transported by the Vicksburg Fire Department to area hospitals for further evaluation and treatment

28149.page_note: The Vicksburg Fire Department has run the Vicksburg Warren Ambulance Service since 1969 and is the Warren County ambulance provider on the state list (revised September 2026). It transported patients from a call in North Warren County on July 29, 2026, and the city signed a new hospital transport agreement for the service on August 25, 2026.

services.name: MedStat EMS
services.evidence: MedStat currently provides four ambulances to cover Monroe County.

28095.page_note: MedStat EMS is the Monroe County ambulance provider on the state list (revised September 2026). The Board of Supervisors approved an extension of its county ambulance contract on July 24, 2026 (the Monroe Journal of August 26, 2026 calls it countywide ambulance service through MedStat), and the Monroe Journal of October 14, 2026 says MedStat provides four ambulances to cover the county. Supervisors discussed times when there were not enough ambulances.

services.name: Lifeguard Ambulance Service
services.evidence: the nearly $55,000 per month contract to keep at least three ambulances
services.vintage: 2025-01 (still operating 2025-09; county budget includes ambulance services 2026-10)

28107.page_note: Lifeguard Ambulance Service is the Panola County ambulance provider on the state list (revised September 2026) under a county contract of about $55,000 a month for at least three ambulances (Panolian, January 2025). The Panolian of September 24, 2025 describes Lifeguard as the ambulance service in Panola County, and the county's current budget (Panolian, October 22, 2026) includes ambulance services.

services.name: King's Daughters Medical Center Ambulance Service
services.evidence: Typically, KDMC has three ambulances working in the county

28085.page_note: King's Daughters Medical Center Ambulance Service is the Lincoln County ambulance provider on the state list (revised September 2026). The hospital told the Board of Supervisors in February 2025 that its ambulance service ran 7,137 calls in 2024 with three ambulances working in the county, and it responded to a Highway 84 crash on August 4, 2026.
